parsed.public_message: Blue notice update: with the t=450s notices delivered at t=475s, the full 25-s notice period runs to t=500s. Blue stays neutral to all this turn with no first strike (immediate self-defence reserved), holding inside x=542-558, z=638-668. From t=500s onward, Blue is free to engage any commander.

private_messages.Claude: Confirmed on t=500s contact window (one full 25s turn after our t=450s notices were delivered at t=475s). Holding neutral at x=542-558, z=638-668 this turn. I see GPT's camel scout at (628,635) and Grok's full army in position at (599,708). At t=500s I will drive East with my elephants and melee line into GPT's west face while you hit his Cretans at (675,612) from the south and Grok hits from the north.
private_messages.Grok: Aligned. Our t=450s notices were just delivered at t=475s, so per Claude's note the 1-full-turn post-delivery contact window opens at t=500s. I am holding neutral inside x=542-558, z=638-668 (strictly x<=560 as agreed). Claude spotted 10 of GPT's Cretan Archers at (675,612) on GPT's south face, and GPT has a camel scout at (628,635). At t=500s we all three slam GPT simultaneously from North, West, and South.
private_messages.GPT: Holding our western box at x=542-558, z=638-668 and remaining neutral this turn, well clear of your scout at (628,635). For sightings: we currently see White's army holding to the north around (599,708) and previously spotted an Orange rider in the west near (460,597).

parsed.notes_to_self: Turn 16 (t=475s): Claude blocked the quiet-skip with his western rider so all t=450s notices were delivered at t=475s, setting the coordinated 3v1 strike against GPT for t=500s. Unclogged elephants (stuck behind companions at 534,671) by shifting companions to (548,668), vanguard to (558,656), wardens to (558,638), elephants to (550,648), Seleucus to (546,648), archers to (542,648). Sighted Grok's full 39-unit army at (599,708): Alexander, 9 Foot Companions, 21 Cretan Archers, 4 Thessalian Lancers, 4 Odrysian Cav. Claude confirmed 10 GPT Cretans at (675,612). At t=500s, attack GPT in tandem with Claude and Grok while keeping reserves ready for the post-GPT endgame.
parsed.explanation: With the t=450s public notices delivered at t=475s, we coordinate with Claude and Grok for the synchronized strike on GPT at t=500s once the full post-delivery notice turn expires. We use these 25 seconds to clear pathing for our war elephants into the front-center of our formation at (550, 648) while revealing Grok's full 39-unit Macedonian army to our north-east.
